nonBlockingIssues.description: test_multi_command_fifo_drain function name says 'FIFO' but the actual drain order is LIFO (Vec::pop). The test correctly verifies LIFO behavior and the doc comment mentions it, but the function name is misleading. Should be renamed to test_multi_command_lifo_drain or test_multi_command_drain.

test_bounded_command_queue_cap cannot directly verify MAX_PENDING_COMMANDS cap because SpaApp does not expose CommandTracker's pending_count(). The test verifies all 9 commands are sent (command_queue is uncapped) and documents the expected tracker behavior in comments. Value is limited — it primarily verifies no panic and no unbounded growth rather than the actual cap.
test_ota_graceful_shutdown_happy_path manually calls begin()/write()/finalize()/mark_valid() rather than using the simulate_ota_download helper. Intentional for intermediate state verification.
test_ota_firmware_size_exceeded allocates ~1.75 MiB for MAX_FIRMWARE_SIZE bytes. Consistent with existing unit test pattern but notably slow.
test_frame_decoder_bus_idle_0x7e function name slightly differs from verificationSteps which says test_frame_decoder_bus_idle. Name is actually more descriptive.
TASKS.md has 3 unchecked items (lines 687, 693, 694) that are stale duplicates of completed protocol-cleanup work. Should be checked off.

appliedUpdates.description: Added note about SpaApp command queue drain order (LIFO via Vec::pop) to architecture.md invariants section.

rejectedObservations.observation: SpaApp lacks public accessor for CommandTracker pending_count, making cap behavior untestable in integration tests.
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented — this is a known API design choice, not a documentation gap. Adding an accessor would change the production API for test-only purposes.
